label: WordPress.net Jobs
terms_note: Community board; posts give a contact — a person applies.

endpoints.call: the RSS feeds (site-wide and per job_category) are usable public feeds
endpoints.notes: from the docs / live response read on 2026-09-05

reference.limits: Not published on the pages opened. Community board run by WordPress.org (WP Job Manager); public RSS, no API, robots.txt one rule; no terms page for the board.

search.note: jobs.wordpress.net WordPress RSS 2.0 feed (10 latest job posts). s is WordPress's feed search (https://wordpress.org/documentation/article/wordpress-feeds/; checked 2026-09-25: ?s=developer narrows the feed) and paged selects older posts (a page past the end answers 404 -> invalid_input). location and limit are not sent. description is the full post (content:encoded, HTML); the excerpt is raw.description and the post id raw['post-id']. id is the job permalink.

not_offered.me: No credentials to verify ('auth: none'): the feed is public and has no account endpoint.
not_offered.get_posting: The feed has no per-item endpoint (each posting's url is an HTML page); search returns the whole record in raw.
not_offered.apply: No application endpoint: the feed only lists postings; candidates apply on each posting's url (employer page / e-mail).
not_offered.list_messages: No messaging API; the only machine-readable interface is the public job feed.
